description: Text transform on cells in column act_dep_time using expression value.toDate("hh:mm A").toString("HH:mm")

expression:
jython:import re
from datetime import datetime

data = [
    '6:00_a.m.',
    '--8:40-a.m.--',
    '__12:15_p.m.__',
    '--7:25-a.m.--',
    '7:15-a.m.',
    '7:00_a.m.',
    '__7:30_a.m.__',
    '--10:45-A.M.--',
    '8:00_a.m.',
    '__3:35_p.m.__',
    '--4:55-p.m.--',
    '2:55-p.m.',
    '__2:55_p.m.__',
    '__1:05_p.m.__',
    '__7:15_P.M.__',
    '7:10-A.M.',
    '6:40-a.m.',
    '9:00-p.m.',
    '__2:30_P.M.__',
    '10:25-a.m.',
]

def standardize_time(time):
    time = re.sub(r'[_-]', '', time)
    if ':' in time:
        hours, minutes = map(int, time.split(':'))
        return "%s" % ({hours}:{minutes:02d})
    else:
        hours, minutes = map(int, time.split('.')[0].split())
        return "%s" % ({hours}:{minutes:02d})

def is_late(scheduled, actual):
    scheduled_time = datetime.strptime(standardize_time(scheduled), "%H:%M")
    actual_time = datetime.strptime(actual, "%H:%M")
    return scheduled_time > actual_time

for row in data:
    if ':' not in row:
        row += '_00'
    standardized = standardize_time(row)
    print(standardized, end=' ')
print()

late_flights = [is_late(data[i], data[i+1]) for i in range(len(data)) if data[i+1]]
print("%s" % (Late flights: {len(late_flights)}))
